_about: Signal source types. role: 'leading' = where colours show up first (forecasts, adult fashion, interiors); 'bridge' = kids fashion / nursery, which usually picks up leading colours before tableware does; 'market' = what children's tableware and feeding products sell now. weight = how much one signal of this type counts. Tune these to your own experience.

forecast_agency.examples: WGSN, Coloro, Pantone, trade-fair trend forums (e.g. Playtime, Kind + Jugend), colour-of-the-year announcements

interiors.examples: Salone del Mobile, Maison&Objet, paint brands' colour of the year, homeware launches

social.examples: Pinterest Predicts, saved Instagram/TikTok nursery and kids' room posts

kids_fashion.examples: kidswear new-in, kids runway, children's fashion trade shows

nursery_interiors.examples: nursery furniture, bedding and toy launches

competitor_launch.examples: new tableware/feeding SKUs and colourways from competitors

retail_bestseller.examples: best-seller lists for kids' tableware on retailer sites

own_sales.examples: your own sell-through by colourway (enter one row per colourway per quarter with weight = units / 100)
